title: Gateway TOFU trust state is volatile and silently resets on restart
description: Security review P2. New rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs TrustStore is only an in-memory HashMap with new/default; it has no durable open/provision/commit format, rollback detection, or fail-closed startup. After any gateway restart all pins and DANE/PKIX upgrades disappear, so every peer becomes first-contact TOFU again and trust can be downgraded/re-established under changed external state. Add crash-safe durable pin/trust-level/key-rotation state with scoped integrity and explicit missing/corrupt/rollback behavior; production startup must not silently replace an existing trust store with empty state; test restart, torn write, corrupt copy, and rollback.
